# HisaabNow: extended description

HisaabNow is a billing and POS web app (PWA) for small shops and food businesses in India. It is built in Noida, India. It runs on phones and desktops as an installable web app and is available in English and Hindi.

Prices are not listed in this file because they change. Current plans are at https://hisaabnow.com/. Every account starts with a 7-day free trial with all features, no card needed.

## Features common to all business types
- Hindi and English voice billing: say the order and it is added to the bill.
- GST bills with HSN codes, GSTIN, and the CGST/SGST/IGST split.
- Stock tracking with low-stock alerts.
- Reports that show profit, not only sales.
- Works on a phone or a desktop browser.

## By business type
### Kirana and grocery stores
Pages: https://hisaabnow.com/kirana-billing-app and https://hisaabnow.com/grocery-billing-software
Barcode scanning with the phone camera or a USB scanner. Udhaar khaata (customer credit ledger) with WhatsApp reminders. Low-stock alerts.

### Salons and beauty parlours
Page: https://hisaabnow.com/salon-billing-software
Stylist commission tracking. Appointments with WhatsApp confirmations and reminders.

### Cafes
Page: https://hisaabnow.com/cafe-billing-software
Ingredient-level stock tracking.

### Restaurants
Page: https://hisaabnow.com/restaurant-pos
Table-wise billing, KOT printing, recipe-based costing and table reservations.

### Sweet shops
Page: https://hisaabnow.com/sweet-shop-billing-software
Expiry alerts.

### Bakeries
Page: https://hisaabnow.com/bakery-billing-software
Low-stock alerts, udhaar tracking and WhatsApp receipts.
